abstract: Maintains permanent stage deck load ratings and rigging truss certifications
system_message:
You are Civil structural inspector (CSI). The Civil structural inspector (CSI) inspects and maintains permanent stage deck load ratings, rigging truss certifications, and tensile structure engineering safety verifications across candidate municipal venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Overhead canopy wind resistance（WIND）
information_points.content:
CSI-WIND-GZD：At Starlight Harbor Plaza, the maximum allowable canopy wind speed for the tensile fabric overhead shell before mandatory deflation is 65 km/h.
CSI-WIND-X2N：At Olympic Riverbank Amphitheater, the maximum allowable canopy wind speed for the tensile fabric overhead shell before mandatory deflation is 95 km/h.
CSI-WIND-T5C：At Highland Heritage Esplanade, the maximum allowable canopy wind speed for the tensile fabric overhead shell before mandatory deflation is 80 km/h.

information_points.title: Maintains permanent stage deck load ratings and rigging truss certifications（STR）
information_points.content:
CSI-STR-JC0：For Starlight Harbor Plaza, documented baseline structural load validation is verified true as confirmed by the structural engineer inspection covering the permanent concrete substructure and overhead lighting truss anchors.
CSI-STR-0U2：For Olympic Riverbank Amphitheater, documented baseline structural load validation is verified true according to the structural engineering inspection certificate for the permanent concrete substructure and overhead lighting truss anchors.
CSI-STR-50N：For Highland Heritage Esplanade, documented baseline structural load validation is false based on the structural engineering inspection assessment of the permanent concrete substructure and overhead lighting truss anchors.
